title: Bookmark Frontmatter
description: content/bookmarks/**/*.md. A bookmark is its own IndieWeb post kind (#251, formerly #219): a saved URL, an optional one-or-two-sentence body, a date. It deliberately does NOT inherit the article contract — no summary requirement, no growth stage, no SEO ritual. The single page is thin by design: it exists as the webmention SOURCE (the receiver fetches it and looks for the u-bookmark-of link) and as the permalink behind the card's date; the card itself links outward to the target.

title.description: What was saved — usually the target page's own title.

slug.description: Optional URL slug override. Use when title contains umlauts (Ä, Ö, Ü, ß) or other special characters.

bookmark_of.description: The saved URL. Rendered as the card's outward link and as u-bookmark-of on the single page; webmention.io delivers it to the target as wm-property 'bookmark-of' once the webmention is sent (#220's flow).

date.description: When the bookmark was saved. Hugo accepts ISO 8601 strings or YAML timestamps; both are valid here. Type intentionally unconstrained so YAML auto-parsed dates (Date objects after gray-matter) don't trip the validator.

lastmod.description: Last-modification date. Override Hugo's git-based default. Type intentionally unconstrained (see `date`).

draft.description: true = excluded from production builds. Flip to false to publish.

weight.description: Sort weight. A positive value pins the card (gold border, top of feed).

categories.description: Optional for bookmarks. When present, the FIRST is the Rubrik badge on the card.
